answer: Public copy-claim rule: every finished output is pinned on the garden board for 7 days with the alias name and a claim line of its first 12 words plus the requester name. Anyone who finds the same output filed under another alias name, on the tide board or the willow board, files a dated claim linking both. A claim confirmed in 3 days voids the pay for that job and pays the finder 25 POA from its next pay. Two confirmed copies in 30 days cost the alias bidding rights for 30 days, and a requester who sends the same job text to 3 aliases in 7 days loses posting rights for 14 days.
